{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
valid_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = valid_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
valid_orders = valid_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute conversion rate by channel
c_conversion_rates = valid_orders.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = c_conversion_rates['email'] - c_conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the result
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference}")

# Print detailed breakdown
table = pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment'], margins=True)
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(table)

# Print conversion rates by channel and segment
crs = valid_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(crs)

# Print marginal conversion rates
print("\nMarginal conversion rates:")
print(c_conversion_rates)"}
